dependencies.$comment: libcurl backs core_http on the platforms whose own HTTP stack the engine cannot reach from C++: Windows and Linux. Apple builds use NSURLSession, Android drives the platform's own HTTP stack over JNI (core_http/HttpBackendAndroid.cpp) and the web build uses the page's fetch, so curl never enters those closures. default-features OFF drops curl's 'non-http' feature (= HTTP_ONLY: no ftp, ldap, smb, ...) and 'ssl' selects the platform's TLS backend - Schannel on Windows, OpenSSL on Linux - so certificate verification always goes through the trust store the platform maintains and the engine never ships a CA bundle.
dependencies.name: curl

render-next.description: Ogre-Next render backend (ORKIGE_RENDER_BACKEND=next - the DEFAULT backend; the default presets macos-debug/macos-release list this feature). Optional so classic-flavor trees (macos-*-classic, ios/android) never build ogre-next; classic ogre stays a base dependency, so a render-next tree carries BOTH backends installed side by side (they are file-disjoint - see ports/ogre-next).
